title: **The Mysterious Disappearance of the Star Dust**

scenes.text: On August 2, 1947, the Star Dust, a British South American Airways DC-4, disappeared while flying over the Andes Mountains.
The Star Dust was a British aircraft that operated between Buenos Aires and Santiago.

scenes.label: No Wreckage
scenes.text: Despite extensive searches, no wreckage or bodies were ever found.
Follow for a new cold case every day.

description: The Star Dust disappearance is one of the most baffling unsolved mysteries in aviation history. The case remains a mystery to this day. Follow us for more unsolved mysteries.
